name: Telco Sellable Bundle
description: A sellable telco bundle composed of up to three linked fee products: initial, monthly recurring, and yearly recurring. All three references are optional so a plan can be billed as any combination of one-off + recurring fees.

inputTip.en: Optional reference to the one-off initial fee product (e.g. setup/activation).
Optional reference to the monthly recurring fee product.
Optional reference to the yearly recurring fee product.
